name: 358-toddle-game
notes: #358 B2.d toddle: a carer strolls a small circle (0.12 u/s) and a little one wobbles after it, 0.15 u behind, arms out, rolling side to side (View/Beats/KidPlay.cs ToddleGame). Every 6-10 s the toddler plops down (squash, a drop, Back); the carer stops, turns, bends to it, and on they go (the end beat). The play-group version, kept for the cheat 'Toddle' (a kid stands in). In the normal game a walking-age baby follows its real carer: 358-toddle.
